title: Josiah knows Max went into the woods to pray

tellings.quote: one is Josiah says you know Max went into the woods and was praying last night

plain: A boy named Josiah, who is among the non-speaking children featured in a documentary about telepathy, is said to have known, without being told, that a man named Max Davis had gone into the woods to pray the night before. The documentary maker Ky Dickens, who made the series The Telepathy Tapes, relays it as an example of these children seeming to read other people's minds.
